{"message": "Sure! Crafting an axe depends on which version of the game you're playing and what kind of axe you want.

**In vanilla Minecraft (Java Edition)**

| Material | Recipe layout (Crafting Table)
|---|---|
| Wooden Axe | Plank – Plank\nStick – Empty\nStick – Empty |
| Stone Axe | Cobble – Cobble\nStick – Empty\nStick – Empty |
| Iron Axe | Iron Ingot – Iron Ingot\nStick – Empty\nStick – Empty |
| Gold Axe | Gold Ingot – Gold Ingot\nStick – Empty\nStick – Empty |
| Diamond Axe | Diamond – Diamond\nStick – Empty\nStick – Empty |
| Netherite Axe | Upgrade a Diamond Axe in a Smithing Table with a Netherite Scrap |

*Tips:* 
• Use a **crafting table** (or your inventory’s small grid if you’re in creative mode).
• Place the *two blocks* of the base material side‑by‑side in the first two slots of the top row.
• Put a *stick* directly below each of those blocks in the second row.
• Finally place another *stick* under the leftmost block in the third row.

If you’re playing Bedrock Edition, the recipes are identical—just drag the ingredients into the correct pattern.

Let me know if you’d like details on gathering the raw materials (wood logs → planks, mining stone/cobblestone, smelting ores), or if you’re working in a different modded setup!"}
